gen-gf-phudu-gf-gotu: Distinctive, ballpoint-plain letters in Phudu keep their line weight constant, with openings on every curve. Gotu moves softer, with gentle stroke shading and open-mouthed e crossbars that keep paragraphs flowing.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-host-grotesk: Curves that sweep open make the text below feel contemporary, while Phudu holds a stencil-cut constant weight up top. Host Grotesk keeps its strokes low in contrast, so paragraphs glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Phudu draws flat, unmodulated letters with generous openings on every curve. IBM Plex Sans Arabic brings the pair its best trait: open apertures and low stroke contrast that make text feel friendly and readable.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Phudu holds the steady line of a technical drafting pen, with generous openings on every curve and plenty of swagger. IBM Plex Sans Hebrew opens its s and c, the real draw.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads with clean, open curve endings, a friendly voice beside the tubular, wire-like letters of Phudu. Together on the page, one shouts in wire while the other speaks quietly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-istok-web: Wiry but loud, Phudu has no thinner parts in its letters, generous openings on every curve. Phudu makes the statement; Istok Web, with rounded letters, does the talking quietly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-jost: Distinctive Phudu opens every curve generously, like a ballpoint's pressure-free line. Jost sits below with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke, so the loud heading has a tidy partner.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-kantumruy-pro: Loud and distinctive, Phudu opens every curve generously. Kantumruy Pro takes over below with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right and no swelling strokes, so text keeps moving.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-kodchasan: Kodchasan hangs its terminals open with no calligraphic thinning, a clean foil for the ballpoint-plain line of Phudu. Its quiet, unfussy shapes leave the heading to do all the shouting.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-koho: Spaghetti turned into letters, courtesy of Phudu, with open curves. KoHo steps in beneath with wide c apertures and a clean manner, giving the wiry heading something sensible to lean on.
